description: Drives the git-flow-next CLI. The CLI owns the workflow semantics — the finish state machine, conflict recovery, and worktree lifecycle — so it must be installed and on PATH; this tool only builds argv. Prefer operation=config/topic/control with subactions; the legacy action aliases remain for compatibility.

auto_update.description: Enable auto-update on base branch definitions.

branch_kind.description: Whether a flow config operation targets a base branch or topic branch type.

config_file.description: Path to a git config file when scope is "file".

control_action.description: Continue or abort an in-progress flow finish operation.

develop_branch.description: Override the develop branch name (default: gitflow.branch.develop config or "develop").

downstream_strategy.description: Merge strategy for flow branch integration.

fetch.description: Fetch the remote before finish when a remote is configured.

ff.description: Use fast-forward behavior when the selected strategy allows it.

force.description: Force re-initialization even if git-flow is already configured.

force_delete.description: Force deletion for topic-delete and config flags.

force_worktree.description: On finish/delete, remove a git-flow-created worktree even with uncommitted changes.

keep_branch.description: Keep the topic branch after finish.

keep_worktree.description: On finish/delete, keep the branch worktree detached instead of removing it.

main_branch.description: Override the main branch name (default: gitflow.branch.master config or "main").

name.description: Branch short name, branch type name, or release/hotfix version depending on the action.

new_name.description: New short name or branch type name for rename operations.

no_create_branches.description: Skip base branch creation during init and only write configuration.

parent.description: Parent/base branch for flow config mutations.

prefix.description: Branch prefix for topic type definitions, such as "feature/".

preserve_merges.description: Preserve merges during rebase-based finish flows.

production_branch.description: NOT SUPPORTED by git-flow-next 2.1.0 init; use preset=gitlab instead.

rebase_before_finish.description: Rebase the topic branch onto its parent before finishing.

recover.description: Which in-progress operation control_action targets (default: finish).

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the local Git repository. If omitted, falls back to the server default set via the GIT_REPO_PATH environment variable or --repo-path CLI argument.

scope.description: Git config scope used for init writes.

shared.description: Write a committable .gitflow file (init, or config edit).

staging_branch.description: NOT SUPPORTED by git-flow-next 2.1.0 init; use preset=gitlab instead.

start_point.description: Configured start point for a topic type.

tag.description: Create an annotated tag when finishing a release or hotfix (default: true).

tag_prefix.description: Tag prefix for flow config mutations.

topic.description: Topic branch type for generalized actions such as topic-start, topic-list, or topic-publish.

upstream_strategy.description: Merge strategy for flow branch integration.

worktree.description: Worktree handling for the branch. finish/delete expose only --keep-worktree and --force-worktree; start and checkout expose --worktree/--no-worktree/--worktree-path. Using the wrong pair raises rather than being silently ignored.

worktree_path.description: Create the worktree at this path instead of the computed one.

worktrees.description: Append a worktree column to a list (only valid with topic_action=list).

name: git_flow
title: Git Flow Actions
